name: Morris
source:
“I-it’s not like I l-like you or anything!”

An experienced MECHANIC who LIKES to act like a TOUGH MOTORHEAD, but he loves THE ARTS and wants to be a SUCCESSFUL POET who gets to leave this BORING town! Can you help him with his dream? OF COURSE YOU CAN!
